info.title: Redaction Policy
info.description: Redaction policy as data the organisation owns: always and never-redact term rules, detection patterns beside the model, and named redaction profiles bound to document types. Objects shipped by OpenRegister carry layer base and a stable slug; the organisation's own carry layer local and are never written by an update.

x-openregister.description: Redaction-policy register shipped by OpenRegister (term rules, detection patterns, redaction profiles); the shipped Woo profile is its base layer.

redaction-policy.title: Redaction Policy
redaction-policy.description: Term rules, detection patterns and redaction profiles the anonymisation engine applies on every path.

termRule.title: Term rule
termRule.summary: A term the engine must always or must never redact.
termRule.description: One entry of the organisation's always-redact or never-redact list. Every detection is matched against both lists; an always match wins. Match types are exactly exact, normalized (case and accent folded), bsn and kvk (the value, or * for any resolved number); any other type is refused at write time.

list.description: always: the matching text is redacted; never: it is released.
list.title: List

entityType.description: Entity type the rule applies to (PERSON, BSN, ORGANIZATION, ...); OTHER or empty applies to every type.
entityType.title: Entity type

matchRules.title: Match rules
matchRules.description: How the rule matches a detection; one matching entry is enough.

value.description: The term, or the number (* for any) for bsn and kvk.

reason.description: Why the term is on the list.
reason.title: Reason

legalAuthority.description: The decision or provision the rule rests on.
legalAuthority.title: Legal authority

bases.description: Exception-ground identifiers (dossiq's list; stored as text, never resolved here) written into a detection's empty grounds.
bases.title: Grounds

validFrom.description: The rule applies from this moment.
validFrom.title: Valid from

validUntil.description: The rule applies until this moment.
validUntil.title: Valid until

active.description: An inactive object does not apply.
active.title: Active

scope.description: organisation: every call; request: only calls whose policyContext.requestRef equals requestRef.
scope.title: Scope

requestRef.description: The request a request-scoped rule belongs to.
requestRef.title: Request

tags.description: Tags a profile selects term rules by (termRuleTags).
tags.title: Tags

source.description: The uuid of the object this rule was imported from (e.g. a filinq prohibition).
source.title: Source

layer.description: base: shipped by OpenRegister and re-imported by slug on every update; local: the organisation's own, never written by an update.
layer.title: Layer

overrides.description: Slug of a base object this local object overrides; with active false it switches that base object off.
overrides.title: Overrides

detectionPattern.title: Detection pattern
detectionPattern.summary: A pattern of the organisation's own that runs as a detection rule beside the model.
detectionPattern.description: A regex or a literal term with the entity type its matches are detected as. Runs on every detection method; its detections carry detectionMethod pattern:<slug>.

pattern.description: The regular expression (without delimiters) or the literal term.
pattern.title: Pattern

entityType.description: The entity type a match is detected as.
entityType.title: Entity type

confidence.description: The confidence a match is reported with.
confidence.title: Confidence

bases.description: Exception-ground identifiers (dossiq's list; stored as text, never resolved here) written into a detection's empty grounds.
bases.title: Grounds

active.description: An inactive object does not apply.
active.title: Active

layer.title: Layer

overrides.description: Slug of a base object this local object overrides; with active false it switches that base object off.
overrides.title: Overrides

redactionProfile.title: Redaction profile
redactionProfile.summary: A named redaction policy applied without restating it.
redactionProfile.description: Which entity types are redacted and kept, how they are replaced, the grounds per entity type and the document types the profile is bound to. Chosen in this order: named in the call, bound to the document type, the organisation default, the shipped Woo profile.

redact.description: Entity types replaced in the output.
redact.title: Redact

keep.description: Entity types left visible in the output.
keep.title: Keep

termRuleTags.description: Term rules carrying one of these tags apply under this profile.
termRuleTags.title: Term rule tags

maskForms.description: Mask form per entity type (e.g. IBAN: last4).
maskForms.title: Mask forms

basesByEntityType.description: Ground identifiers per entity type, written into a detection's empty grounds.
basesByEntityType.title: Grounds by entity type

documentTypes.description: Document types this profile is bound to.
documentTypes.title: Document types
